name: Argent Return
descriptionTemplate: At the start of the battle, gain [Arg4] {STR}, and increase the Keyflare Cap by 100%. The Keyflare gained per point of Arithmetica consumed +100%. After using {Keyflare Rouse} or unleashing Posse, gain Temporary {STR} equal to 20% of the current {STR} and grant all Awakeners 20 Aliemus.

variants.name: Argent Return: Sorrow
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At the start of the battle, gain [Arg4] <PowerIconKeywords:STR>, and increase the Keyflare Cap by 100%. The Keyflare gained per point of Arithmetica consumed +100%. After using Keyflare Rouse or unleashing Posse, gain Temporary <PowerIconKeywords:STR> equal to 20% of the current <PowerIconKeywords:STR> and grant all Awakeners 20 Aliemus.

variants.name: Argent Return: Fear
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: All awakeners' Exalt Final DMG +100%. Each time Exalt is released, obtain Keyflare equal to 500% of the Awakener's Base Aliemus, and decrease all Awakeners' Base Aliemus by 20, up to 5 times.

variants.name: Argent Return: Scathe
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: Hand Limit +5. At turn start, draw 2 cards and gain 2 Arithmetica. Each time the deck is reset, gain [Arg3] <PowerIconKeywords:STR> and [Arg4] Temporary <AlertIconKeywords:Alert>, generate 1 of each Non-Derived Command Card for the highest Aliemus Awakener and place them into the Draw Pile, reducing their Arithmetica cost by 1.

variants.name: Argent Return: Deceit
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At turn start, all Awakeners gain 25 Aliemus and draw a <DerivativeCardKeywords_4:Insight> into their hand. After unleashing "Exalt" 4 times, remove the <Seal:Sealed> status from all Awakeners and grant them 50 Aliemus.

variants.name: Argent Return: Heresy
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: Effects of <RetaliateIconKeywords:Counter>, <IntoxicationIconKeywords:Poison>, Shield, and HP Recovery generated by all Awakeners +50%. At the end of the turn, gain Temporary <RetaliateIconKeywords:Counter> equal to 500% of the current Shield.

variants.name: Argent Return: Madness
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At the start of the battle, choose 3 cards to grant them "<RippleKeywords:Aftershock>: Draw a card and gain [Arg3] Temporary <PowerIconKeywords:STR>". At the start of the turn, draw 2 cards with <RippleKeywords:Aftershock>, all <RippleKeywords:Aftershock> effects trigger an additional time. After triggering <RippleKeywords:Aftershock> 10 times, put 1 <DerivativeCardKeywords_1:Echoes of Lost Shadows> into your hand.

variants.name: Argent Return: Birth
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: Increase Final DMG by 250%. Each time damage is dealt, this bonus -50% (up to 5 times), while Shield Generation +10%. Resets every turn.
